name: Houston We Have a New Event 2027
information:
# Southern Cubing welcomes you to Katy, Texas for Houston We Have a New Event 2027, the first WCA competition in Texas to feature the new Face Turning Octahedron event!

# ALL COMPETITORS MUST REVIEW THE 4-PAD INFORMATION TAB BEFORE REGISTERING.

# Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
